trademarkOppositionCompetition.title: Trademark Opposition Competition (TOC)

commemoration.name: Prof. Tehemtan N. Daruwalla
commemoration.text: The competition is hosted in commemoration of Prof. Tehemtan N. Daruwalla, an alumnus of Government Law College (LL.B.) who qualified as a Solicitor in 1960. He pioneered the practice of Trade Mark and Patent Law in India, taught the LL.M. course in Intellectual Property at Mumbai University from 1976, and taught at GLC Mumbai from 1979 to 1992, shaping generations of leading IP attorneys.

trademarkOppositionCompetition.overview: India's first-of-its-kind Trademark Opposition Competition simulating opposition proceedings under Section 21 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999 read with Rule 42 to Rule 50 of the Trade Marks Rules, 2017 in two phases, Inter (National) and Intra (Institutional) level competition.

tracks.eligibility: Open to LL.B. & Integrated Law students across BCI-recognized law schools nationwide
tracks.format: Two-Phase Competition: (1) Written Submissions under Rules 42–47 of the Trade Marks Rules, 2017 read with Section 21 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999. (2) Oral Argument rounds under Rule 50 read with Section 21 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999.
tracks.skillsTested: Notice filing, evidence submission, counter-statements, oral opposition advocacy before the Registrar.

tracks.eligibility: Exclusively for students of Government Law College, Mumbai
tracks.format: Streamlined oral advocacy rounds strictly under Rule 50 of the Trade Marks Rules, 2017 read with Section 21 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999, focusing on live argument, cross-rebuttals, and procedural precision before the Registrar.
tracks.skillsTested: Oral advocacy, procedural presentation, registrar argument tactics.
